title: Oman’s Bank Dhofar to issue $400mln in AT1 capital instruments
summary: The issuance will be carried out under the bank’s $500 million EMTN programme

contentHtml:
Muscat, Oman - 25th Feb 2026: View across densely packed rooftops in Muscat showing low rise buildings spread across the urban environment with natural mountains beyond. Image used for illustrative purpose. Image courtesy: Getty Images/ Craig Hastings

The issuance will be carried out under the bank’s $500 million EMTN programme

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

The board of directors of Oman’s Bank Dhofar has approved the issuance of up to OMR154 million ($400 million), or its equivalent in US dollars or other major currencies, in Additional Tier 1 (AT1) capital instruments.
